info.title: INSYS Core static data API
info.description: Generated endpoints for the static data tables of every module, and their governance: change requests, approval and imports. Every response carries X-Correlation-Id: the caller's when it sent a valid one, else a new one; errors repeat it as correlationId. x-function lists the functions an operation belongs to (ADR-026): the caller needs any one of them, one per portal for an operation the portals share. Operations about the signed-in user and signed provider callbacks have none.

get.summary: List Channel definitions in force
get.description: Channel definitions records in force on asAt (default today), tenant rows over global baselines (SDM-008, SDM-015).

post.summary: Create a tenant Channel definitions draft
post.description: Creates version 1 of a new code, or the next version of an existing one. The caller is the maker.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get the Channel definitions version in force
List every tenant version of a Channel definitions code

put.summary: Edit a tenant Channel definitions draft
put.description: Only the maker edits a draft; approved versions are immutable (SDM-002).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last GET (row_version, DBA-011). Missing gives 428; stale gives 412.

post.summary: Submit, activate, deprecate or retire a tenant Channel definitions version
post.description: submit sends the draft for approval (approve and reject are on the same path, decided in Workflow); activate puts an approved version in force; deprecate stops new use; retire hides it (SDM-007). Completes asynchronously (GAP-027): after submit, the change request and its Workflow approval appear (GET /api/v1/static-data/change-requests, GET /api/v1/workflow/approvals); until then approve and reject return 404. Activation's cache refreshes follow too.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last GET (row_version, DBA-011). Missing gives 428; stale gives 412.

post.x-eventual-effects: after submit, the change request and its Workflow approval appear (GET /api/v1/static-data/change-requests, GET /api/v1/workflow/approvals); until then approve and reject return 404. Activation's cache refreshes follow too.

post.summary: Import tenant Channel definitions drafts, all or nothing
post.description: Every line is validated; if any line fails, nothing is saved and each rejected line is reported (SDM-012).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

code.description: The stable error code (the error code catalogue), for example VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED or NOT_READY. Present on every error except a malformed request (400, 405, 415) rejected before an endpoint runs.

errors.description: Validation failures (422): field name, as the request body spells it (camel case, with a path such as lines[0].amount for a nested field), to its messages.

correlationId.description: The same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header, on every error (GAP-007).

traceId.description: The server's trace identifier, for support.

detailLanguage.description: Present when the detail stayed in English because the catalogue has no detail in the title's language; its value is then "en".

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is stable and never localised; `title` and `detail` follow the request's language.

expiresAfter.description: How long an approval of this type waits for a decision before it expires: an ISO 8601 duration of at least one hour, for example P14D or PT48H. An approval type with no row in force expires after 14 days.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency the limit is in. A limit counts only for approvals in its currency; empty means the tenant's base currency.
The ISO 4217 currency the limit is in. A limit counts only for approvals in its currency; empty means the tenant's base currency.

Problem403.description: Forbidden. Codes any operation may return: FORBIDDEN, TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING, FUNCTION_NOT_GRANTED, FUNCTION_DISABLED, FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, CHANNEL_NOT_ENABLED, CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED, CHANNEL_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

Problem409.description: Conflict. Codes any operation may return: TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, IDEMPOTENCY_RESPONSE_NOT_KEPT, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

Problem422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Codes any operation may return: VALIDATION_FAILED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The request's correlation ID: the caller's X-Correlation-Id when it sent a valid one, else a new one. Errors carry it in correlationId too.

Content-Language.description: The language of the error's title (docs/specs/addenda/localisation.md §4).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

bearer.description: OIDC access token carrying sub and tenant_id. Permissions come from IAM role assignments.
